description: For teachers/educators ONLY. Pre-show event where teachers/educators can connect with each other, share ideas and hear from the Participate team, as well as meet a member/s of the 1984 creative team.
htmlDescription:
1984: Teachers' Prologue


This pre-show event is for Drama and English teachers only. It must be booked along with a 1984 ticket for the 7.30pm performance on 01 Septmeber.

Connect with fellow Drama and English teachers and meet the passionate team behind the Citizens Theatre Participate department in a relaxed and engaging space.

Meet a member of the 1984 creative team, and get a unique insight into the creative processes behind professional theatre-making.

Enjoy tea, coffee, and snacks as you mingle and contribute to strengthening the network of educators in Glasgow and beyond.
name: 1984: Teachers’ Prologue
